name: Mento Brazilian Real
oneLiner: BRLm is Mento's Brazilian real stablecoin on Celo, minted CDP-style against USDm collateral (Mento V3, a Liquity v2 fork).
collateral: Mento V3 Liquity-v2-style CDPs collateralized by USDm; USDm in turn is backed by the diversified Mento Reserve mix (sUSDS, CELO, EURC, USDC, USDT, axlEUROC, stETH, and smaller positions exposed via the Mento reserve dashboard).
pegMechanism: Mento V3 oracle-priced FX stablecoin minted by depositing USDm as CDP collateral and borrowing BRLm against it; user-set interest rates, Stability Pool liquidations, and Liquity-style redemptions support the BRLm peg, with circuit breakers and Mento reserve transparency on the upstream USDm leg.
